page_title: CRY 5-2 WHU | Crystal Palace v West Ham 21/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+4' Maxwel Cornet (West Ham) is caught offside!
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
89' 5 - 2 An unfortunate moment for Dean Henderson (Crystal Palace), who has scored an own goal.
85' Substitution. Mohammed Kudus makes his way off the pitch and Maxwel Cornet (West Ham) comes on as his replacement.
83' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) misses a golden opportunity to score from inside the six-yard box after firing the ball over the crossbar.
81' Here is a change. Eberechi Eze is going off and Oliver Glasner gives the last tactical orders to Jeffrey Schlupp (Crystal Palace).
81' Substitution. Jairo Riedewald (Crystal Palace) has come on for Will Hughes.
80' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) shows off his individual ability with a jinking run into the box. Unfortunately, the finish lets him down as the ball flies well wide of the right post.
75' Substitution. Edson Alvarez makes way for Kalvin Phillips (West Ham).
75' David Moyes has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Danny Ings (West Ham) replacing Michail Antonio.
71' 59:41 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
68' Oliver Glasner prepares a substitution. Jean-Philippe Mateta is replaced by Odsonne Edouard (Crystal Palace).
68' Here's the change. Michael Olise leaves the pitch and Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) comes on as a substitute.
67' The attendance is 25145.
66' Naouirou Ahamada (Crystal Palace) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Graham Scott had an easy-decision to make.

64' 5 - 1 Eberechi Eze feeds the ball through to Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace), who picks up the pass inside the box and quickly sends it into the bottom left corner! The goalkeeper was helpless. 5:1!
62' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
61' Oliver Glasner is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Adam Wharton suffers an injury and Naouirou Ahamada (Crystal Palace) comes on.
59' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
57' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
53' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Graham Scott no option but to blow his whistle.
50' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.

50' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the bottom right corner, but Lukasz Fabianski pulls off an exquisite save to deny him. The ball is out of play. Crystal Palace win a corner kick.
49' West Ham enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Angelo Ogbonna (West Ham) comes off for Aaron Cresswell.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. David Moyes gives a chance to Benjamin Johnson and Tomas Soucek (West Ham) is off.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+8' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+8' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) receives a yellow card from the referee, but it seems like a very harsh decision.
45+8' That's a clear yellow card. Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) goes into the book.
45+3' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) is flagged for offside.
45+3' Joachim Andersen (Crystal Palace) jumps for a cross in the goal area and produces a fine header which goes just a few inches over the bar! What a huge opportunity!
45+2' Crystal Palace take a short corner kick.
45+2' The free kick is taken by Michael Olise (Crystal Palace), but ball is cleared. Crystal Palace have a corner.
45' We will have 7 min. of added time.
45' A nice lofted cross finds Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) unmarked. He takes an excellent touch and gets in a shot that goes towards the bottom right post, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save!
43' Graham Scott sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
41' Wait! Referee Graham Scott has indicated he is going to review the West Ham goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
40' 4 - 1 Gooal! Michail Antonio (West Ham) scores with a shot from inside the box after latching onto a headed pass from Tomas Soucek. He makes it 4:1.
39' Graham Scott shows a yellow card to Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) for his blatant foul.
37' Crystal Palace quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

37' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. The referee signals a corner kick to Crystal Palace.
36' Michail Antonio (West Ham) wins the ball from the resulting free kick and blazes his shot high over the crossbar!

34' What a chance that is! Angelo Ogbonna (West Ham) squanders a huge opportunity as he latches on to a perfect cross from the wing. He produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes high over the crossbar!

31' 4 - 0 Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) has acres of space after latching on to a precise pass into the box. He doesn't hesitate to release a low effort which ends up in the middle of the net.
30' Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) goes for goal but he directs his effort just wide of the left post.
29' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
27' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Michail Antonio (West Ham) was quite harsh and Graham Scott didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
27' Close! Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) unleashes a rocket of a shot from the edge of the box and his shot flies just a few inches over the crossbar.
26' Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the top right corner only for Lukasz Fabianski to dive and make a save.
24' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) unleashes a cannonball of a shot from the edge of the area, but it zips narrowly wide of the left post.
23' 6:0 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
20' 3 - 0 An unfortunate own goal is conceded by Emerson (West Ham), who attempted to smack the ball away, but instead he sends it into his own net.
16' 2 - 0 GOAL! Great reaction there from Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace), who acrobatically contorts his body to score inside the box from a rebound. It’s 2:0.

16' Great save! Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the bottom left corner was brilliantly saved by Lukasz Fabianski.
14' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Lukasz Fabianski, who smothers the ball.
11' The ball spins to Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) on the edge of the box. He hits across the ball and sends it goalwards, but it goes just wide of the left post.
9' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) sends in a shot from a promising distance after a precise pass. His effort goes inches over the crossbar.

7' 1 - 0 It's a goal! Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) makes it 1:0. He jumped highest to connect with a perfect cross from Joachim Andersen and planted his close-range header into the left side of the goal. Lukasz Fabianski was helpless.
6' Corner kick. Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) is ready to send the ball into the box.
6' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender. Crystal Palace earn a corner.
5' Graham Scott blows for a foul after Tomas Soucek (West Ham) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
2' West Ham seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
1' The match has just started.
Crystal Palace will kick the game off.
Graham Scott is the one to supervise the game today.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
